app.title: Horible public key tricks
app.description: A collection of insecure public key handling patterns and tools to generate vulnerable certificates for testing crypto libraries.
proposed_tests: Generate a self-signed certificate with badcert CLI
Attempt to load the certificate with OpenSSL and verify failure
Import the certificate into a Python script and test handshake
Compare performance with a correctly generated cert
